newsitem.title: UK: CSFB starts W. Europe private equity banking unit.
newsitem.headline: CSFB starts W. Europe private equity banking unit.

text.p: CS First Boston said it will establish a Western European private equity and merchant banking business under the leadership of Alec D'Janoeff who has joined CSFB from Coopers & Lybrand.

D'Janoeff said the group will focus on medium to large sized businesses throughout Western Europe, particularly units of larger groups and family-owned companies where shareholders are seeking liquidity or corporate divestments.
"Although there is a very sophisticated MBO (management buy-out) market in the UK, it is still a relatively underdeveloped concept in Continental Europe," D'Janoeff said.
D'Janoeff set up an MBO team at Coopers & Lybrand which worked on deals involving Parker Pen, Reedpack and TAG Heuer.
CSFB said the group will invest primarily from CSFB and Credit Suisse's balance sheets but may look to raise funds from external sources in the future.
